notes: BUU 2.0 v2.3.0 - the rebuild. New: Schedules page (run spreadsheet-free flows at set times - daily/weekly/monthly/once, timezone-aware, missed-run recovery), spreadsheet-free once-flows run directly from the Run button, step debugger with a persistent pane (redo/back/skip/restart controls, live flow reload while paused), {{TODAY}}/{{RUNDATE}} date tokens with +/-N day math, press-key-after-typing on Type steps, unified Click options, dialog accept/decline checkboxes, adaptive worker scaling, error strip on the run screen, step reorder buttons, flow folders, unsaved-changes prompts, and pool settings saved with each flow. NOTE: this update moves BUU to C:\BUU - your first launch copies flows and logs over automatically (the old copies in AppData are left untouched), and taskbar pins survive future updates from now on.
